source.snippet: I wish there was a tool as good as Skitch for Linux. Deepin Screenshots come close but it has (had?) issues with Wayland.

problem_statement: Linux desktop users lack a polished, Wayland-compatible screenshot annotation tool comparable to Skitch on macOS, forcing them to use workarounds with partial Wayland support.
target_segment: Linux power users and developers who use Wayland-based desktops and need annotation/screenshot tooling in their daily workflow.
notes: Older signal (2022) but the Wayland adoption curve has only grown since. Single comment; no direct payment signal. Hobbyist lean, but developers using Linux workstations do pay for productivity tools. Low confidence without corroboration.
